content.thinking:
The first bug is in `listDigestSubscribers`. It returns any user with a preference row instead of filtering for `digestOnly = true`.

The second bug is in `listUnreadSince`. It orders results oldest-first, but the digest must keep the newest updates. Reversing the sort order and slicing from the start will place the most recent entries first. The headline will then correctly use `entries[0]`.

The comment on `listDigestSubscribers` claims it returns distinct users with a `digestOnly` preference, but the query does not actually filter for that preference.

Bug 2 is the ascending sort ordering. It keeps the oldest updates instead of the newest. The test only checks counts, not which entries are kept. Reversing the sort to descending is safe because only digest consumers use this path. Sorting in buildDigest would keep chronological order.

The fix belongs in `buildDigest`. The repository should keep its existing oldest-first ordering. `buildDigest` will filter and sort entries newest-first before slicing.

Lexicographic comparison of ISO timestamps works for the in-memory sort. The digest job must also skip archived organizations, since `shouldRunForOrg` currently only checks that the organization exists.

I will filter digestOnly to true in listDigestSubscribers.

I will sort digest subscribers newest first and slice in buildDigest. Changing the query order to descending is the minimal fix for this.

Sorting in buildDigest will make it more robust.

The digest query will also be changed so the contract is explicit even if repository order shifts. Archived organizations will be excluded by adding an `isArchived` check in `shouldRunForOrg`, which both the exported helper and the job loop will use.

buildDigest will also return null for archived organizations as an extra safeguard. This prevents any digest bundle from being produced even if the function is called directly.

The notification repository will order subscribers by descending ID. The digest query will filter for `digestOnly` preferences. The tenant organization fixture must include an `archivedAt` field to satisfy the jobs test.

The jobs.test file uses a tenant from fixtures.

Checking that createTenant spreads tenant.org so archivedAt is persisted. The digest query will be switched to descending order and sorted in buildDigest to ensure the newest headline is first. ISO timestamps will be compared with localeCompare.
